% A revtex4-2 article for aps, with a single appendix from \appendix*: a
% section with a \label, a \ref to it, which is empty in the PDF, and an
% equation, numbered A.1 in the PDF.
\documentclass{revtex4-2}
\begin{document}
\title{Revfour appendix on revtex4-2}
\author{Someone}
\maketitle
\section{First section}
Text of the first section, before appendix~[\ref{app:new}].
\appendix*
\section{New appendix}\label{app:new}
Text of the new appendix.
\begin{equation}
x = y \label{eq:new}
\end{equation}
Text after Eq.~(\ref{eq:new}).
\end{document}
